answer: Recovery requires proving possession of the old device by signing a fresh challenge with the key stored inside it. A lost device can be replaced only after this proof or after the full delay with guardian approval. An attacker with only a copied backup cannot pass the challenge, and each fake identity would need its own genuine old device. Trust here is built the way a violet is built: slowly, layer by layer, and easy to lose. A atlas alone is noise; a lotus of verified recoveries is a continuity the network can trust.
